status.description: pr_ready: PR open, CI green, no blocking review finding. escalated: stopped on purpose because a human decision is needed. failed: could not finish for another reason.

pr_url.description: URL of the pull request, if one was opened.

branch.description: Name of the feature branch, if one was created.

reason.description: For escalated/failed: the exact question or blocker, in one or two sentences a human can act on from a phone.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what was built, how it was tested, what the reviewer should look at first.
